    ci: run pi-action on issues and PRs as the pi-action-agent App
    
    pi acts with a GitHub App installation token instead of GITHUB_TOKEN,
    so its PRs run CI and its tags run release.yml. The job skips events
    from bots, so pi's own comments and question edits can't start runs.
